taxonomy.name: Espresso Taste and Extraction
taxonomy.definition: How the shots taste and extract: sour, bitter, thin or syrupy results, channeling, uneven extraction, dialing in beans and roast, pre-infusion and flow profiling effects.

taxonomy.name: Brew Temperature Stability
taxonomy.definition: Accuracy and consistency of brew and group temperature, PID control, readout versus measured temperature, and stability across back-to-back shots.

taxonomy.name: Warm-Up Speed and Scheduling
taxonomy.definition: How long the machine takes to become ready from cold or standby, plus timers, wake schedules and eco sleep modes.

taxonomy.name: Built-in Grinder Performance
taxonomy.definition: Grind consistency, adjustment steps, retention, clumping, dosing accuracy, hopper and burr design, and grinder alignment or burr swapping.

taxonomy.name: Steam Wand and Milk Texturing
taxonomy.definition: Steam wand power, speed, articulation and safety, microfoam quality, milk temperature, spraying or sputtering, and plant milk behavior.

taxonomy.name: Noise and Vibration
taxonomy.definition: Loudness of the grinder, pump and steaming, buzzer beeps, vibration, and how disruptive the machine is to the household.

taxonomy.name: Touchscreen, Controls and Settings
taxonomy.definition: Usability of the display, dial, buttons, menus, profile programming, saved profiles, responsiveness, readability and lock or firmware features.

taxonomy.name: Cleaning, Descaling and Maintenance
taxonomy.definition: Routine upkeep: descaling, backflush, self-clean, drip tray and puck handling, grounds mess, filters, consumables and maintenance reminders.

taxonomy.name: Customer Support, Warranty and Repairs
taxonomy.definition: Experiences with service and help desks, warranty claims, repair availability and turnaround, spare parts and replacements.

taxonomy.name: Design, Size and Delivery
taxonomy.definition: Physical build and footprint, colors and finish, water tank and refilling, cable length, packaging, shipping damage and documentation.

taxonomy.name: Overall Verdict and Value
taxonomy.definition: Whether the machine is worth buying, returning or keeping, price and value judgments, and mixed overall assessments.

taxonomy.name: Video Content and Requests
taxonomy.definition: Feedback on the video's production and scoring jokes, and viewer requests for tests, comparisons, tutorials or future episodes.
